product.description:
TheBalm Travel Makeup Set is a perfect collection of beauty essentials for creating a complete, radiant makeup look. This set includes Lash Mascara, Hot Mama Blush, Bahama Mama Bronzer, and Mary-Lou Manizer Highlighter. From beautifully defined lashes to a fresh cheek color, sun-kissed warmth, and a luminous glow, these makeup favorites are ideal for everyday use, travel, and special occasions.

What’s Included:

  • Lash Mascara: Enhances the appearance of lashes for a defined look.

Product Type: Travel Makeup Set

Perfect For: Everyday makeup, travel, and gifting.
